implemented: Authenticated POST/v2/aetherpd/start requires exact GUI UUID/handle plus IQ channel1..4 and nonzero pan, bounded to512 bytes. Existing v1 remains two-field legacy startup; neither endpoint accepts the other schema.

Go encodes PDSTART2 directly and keeps the original root socket peer check. Selected startup queries only private status until matching native local_dax_iq channel/pan/GUI readback is valid, within the existing20s overall deadline. Missing support, mismatch, failure, cancellation or token revocation retires that session with no v1 retry.

Native sealed sessions emit immutable identity plus valid/failed readback state in feedback_binding. Strict shim parsing exposes only this bounded object, refuses contradictory active-source/correction states, and reports binding_pending/binding_failed separately from successful calibration.

Desktop protocol parses the six-field binding object and distinguishes pending and failed states. Model and existing controls refuse source/correction actions without valid binding and provide accessible reasons.

Desktop rejects binding for a different original GUI; any binding loss, identity change or metadata disappearance invalidates prepared capture generations. Restored readback cannot revive an old preparation.
Shared strict JSON object decoding preserves duplicate/null/unknown-field checks for start and tone requests. No new privileged operation, RF command or automatic rearm is introduced.

validation.added_native_go_interop_test: Passed separately with supplied native fixture and parser; production Go source identical to full-race run except a mutation restored byte-for-byte.

composed_protocol.scope: Current compiled components and real generated JSON/frames; no radio, installed process graph or RF.

preserved_initial_failures: Pending/cancel fixture used httptest non-LAN peer and correctly got403; fixed fixture address, not ingress policy.
Standalone Qt fixture/sanitizer compiler omitted project fPIC, causing protected-symbol link failure; rebuilt with fPIC.
Added binding polls changed an old tone-edit request count baseline; assertion now snapshots immediately before editing and still requires exactly zero new requests.

Capture snapshot and export provenance do not yet include immutable feedback binding. Prepared-capture invalidation is implemented but is not a substitute for snapshot metadata.
